transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… it’s my eating. Most nights after my wife goes to bed, I end up in the kitchen and eat a lot more than I should. Like not just a plate—fried chicken, mac and cheese, rolls, leftovers from events… sometimes it feels like half the fridge is gone.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating once you've started during these late-night episodes?
Yeah… I do. Once I take that first bite, it’s like… I don’t know, the choice is already gone. I’ll be telling myself, “George, stop,” but I’m still making another plate or opening something else.
Do you feel guilty or ashamed after these late-night eating episodes?

Yeah. I mean… very guilty. Ashamed, too. Afterward I just sit there feeling sick with myself, like everyone thinks I’m this organized, strong guy, and then I’m there disgusted that I let it happen again.
Do you feel like you're in control of what you're eating during these episodes?
Not really. Once I take that first bite, it’s like… the decision’s already made. I’ll be telling myself, “George, stop now,” but my hands are still fixing another plate or opening another container.
How long does it usually take you to eat all that food during these late-night episodes?

Usually pretty fast. I don’t really time it, but… I’m eating so quickly I barely taste it, even stuff I cooked myself. Sometimes I’m just standing at the counter, taking big bites before I’ve even finished chewing the last one.
Do you feel like you're eating much more rapidly than normal during these episodes?

Yeah… I do. It’s a lot faster than how I’d normally eat. I barely taste it, even food I actually cooked, and sometimes I’m just standing there swallowing big bites before I’ve really finished chewing.
Do these episodes of eating more than you should only happen at night?

Mostly, yeah. It’s usually after my wife goes to bed. I end up in the kitchen and… it turns into way more than a normal plate. Leftovers, trays from events, whatever’s there. Sometimes it feels like half the fridge is gone.
Are you usually feeling stressed, anxious, or upset before these late-night eating episodes happen?
I don’t know… I haven’t really paid attention to that part. Sometimes I’m just up and it happens. I’m not sure if it’s always stress or anything like that.
Do you think you're feeling stressed or anxious right before you start eating at night?
I’m not really sure. I mean… maybe sometimes, but I don’t notice it clearly right before. It just sort of happens.
Do you feel like you have no control over how much you're eating during these episodes?

Yeah… I guess that’s the part that bothers me. Once I start, it feels like it’s already decided. I’ll be telling myself, like, “George, stop,” but I’m still making another plate or opening something else.
Do you feel like you're unable to control how much you eat during these episodes?
Yeah… I do. Once I take that first bite, it’s like it’s already out of my hands. I can be telling myself, “George, stop,” but I’m still getting more food.
Do you usually try to hide or conceal the evidence of your late-night eating from your wife or others?
I… I don’t really know. I mean, I might throw things away or clean up a bit, but I haven’t really thought about whether I’m trying to hide it.
Do these episodes of eating more than you should ever happen during the day?
I’m not really sure. I mostly think of it as happening later, but… I guess I haven’t paid close attention to whether it happens during the day too.
Do you think you eat more when you're feeling upset or emotional?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I haven’t really tracked it like that. It just kind of happens.
Do you usually feel stressed or anxious right before you start eating at night?
I’m not sure. I don’t always notice what I’m feeling right before… it just sort of happens, I guess.
Do you feel stressed or anxious right before you start eating at night?
I don’t really know. I can’t say I notice feeling anxious right before… by then I’m usually just kind of on autopilot.
Do you think your late-night eating happens in response to feeling upset or emotional?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think of it that way when it’s happening… it’s more like I just end up eating, and I don’t really stop to figure out why.
Do you ever feel guilty or ashamed about your eating during the day?
Yeah… I do. Afterward, mostly. I feel pretty ashamed, like… disgusted with myself that I let it happen again. People think I’ve got things together, so it’s hard to admit.
Do you usually eat alone during these late-night episodes?
I guess… usually, yeah. I don’t really like people seeing me do that, so it tends to happen when I’m by myself.
